q-357050.name: Question 1
q-357050.problem:
If $∠X$ and $∠Y$ are complementary angles and $m∠X={47}^{∘}$, then $m∠Y=${{field-1}}
${}^{∘}.$
q-357050.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14186058/assets/8079f80c1adad20a0844885f06cb56feb8fc55d8172aa154d4d2c484c3b977cc.png)

Since $∠X$ and $∠Y$ are complementary, the sum of their measures is equal to ${90}^{∘}.$ So, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠X+m∠Y & ={90}^{∘} \\ {47}^{∘}+m∠Y & ={90}^{∘} \\ m∠Y & ={43}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
